latin: Anima aquea, ut inferiora generat, superiora contemplatur in seipsa se sistit, triplici hymno maris, Neptunni, et oceani ab orpheo decantatur.
translation: The watery soul, as it generates the lower things, contemplates the higher things and stands still in itself, is sung by Orpheus in a threefold hymn, of the Sea, of Neptune, and of Ocean.
